scope: 2026-09-28 source-recheck-derived bilingual usage guidance. All examples are synthetic and require the user's data; collocations are writing aids, not source quotations.

cards.zh: 全外显子测序；配对正常/胚系对照
collocations: variants detected in the assayed regions
cards.use_when: 写清测序覆盖、正常对照来源及胚系确认方式。
cards.confusable: 肿瘤单独测序的疑似胚系变异不是配对正常样本确认的胚系变异。
cards.safe_example: Variants were classified using [sequencing assay] and [available matched-normal evidence].
cards.unsafe_example: Tumor-only WES confirmed every inherited variant.
cards.boundary: WES是基因组学；本词条不能替用户补充未做的正常对照。

cards.zh: 免疫印迹；磷酸化读出
cards.use_when: 区分基线水平、处理后变化、总蛋白和磷酸化蛋白；注明比较方向。
cards.confusable: 处理后诱导更强不等于基线更高，也不等于细胞毒性更强。
cards.safe_example: Treatment produced greater relative induction of [phosphorylation readout], without a corresponding increase in [cytotoxic endpoint].
cards.unsafe_example: Stronger STING phosphorylation proved universal chemotherapy sensitization.
cards.boundary: 靶向蛋白实验不是全局蛋白组；只能描述实际检测的蛋白和条件。

cards.zh: 条件比例与分母方向
cards.use_when: 先确认是在蛋白缺失组内统计变异类型，还是在某变异类型内统计蛋白缺失。
cards.confusable: P(变异类别|蛋白缺失)不等于P(蛋白缺失|变异类别)。
cards.safe_example: Among [protein-loss tumors], [fraction] carried [variant class]; this is not the class-specific probability of protein loss.
cards.unsafe_example: Most loss-positive tumors were truncating, so most truncating tumors had protein loss.
cards.boundary: 不得反转柱图分母；原文摘要和图注不一致时保留冲突。

cards.zh: 突变、等位基因状态与功能缺失分层
cards.use_when: 分别写变异致病性、拷贝数、等位基因状态、RNA及蛋白证据。
cards.confusable: 单等位缺失不是完全失活；突变加拷贝缺失不自动证明已定相的双等位失活。
cards.safe_example: [Alteration class] was associated with lower [protein measure], but complete functional loss was not established.
cards.unsafe_example: Any STK11 variant proves biallelic LKB1 loss.
cards.boundary: MTAP的GCN<0.6判据不能迁移成STK11阈值。

cards.zh: 缺失范围：整基因与部分外显子
collocations: deletion of one or more exons
cards.use_when: 先说明本文complete/partial指缺失范围还是功能程度。
cards.confusable: MTAP文章中两类均按纯合缺失定义，不能译成双等位与单等位缺失。
cards.safe_example: Both categories met the homozygous-loss criterion; they differed in the extent of exon coverage.
cards.unsafe_example: Partial MTAP loss means monoallelic deletion.
cards.boundary: 基因特异操作性定义必须保留。

cards.zh: 任一基因改变的并集；双突变交集
collocations: mutant irrespective of the other gene
cards.use_when: 明确是否含单突变、双突变及其归组优先级。
cards.confusable: STK11 and/or KEAP1不是仅STK11/KEAP1双突变；STK11-mutant也不等于STK11-only。
cards.safe_example: The union included tumors with either alteration alone or both alterations.
cards.unsafe_example: All patients in the either-gene subgroup had both mutations.
cards.boundary: 不能用合并亚组结果替代单基因独立效应。

cards.zh: 未检出、未检测与统计互斥
cards.use_when: 报告检测该基因的真实分母及检验方法。
cards.confusable: 面板未覆盖不是野生型；小样本零共现不是普遍互斥。
cards.safe_example: No [alteration] was observed in the assayed subgroup; limited coverage precluded a strong exclusivity claim.
cards.unsafe_example: No recorded STK11 mutation proves biological incompatibility with Q61L.
cards.boundary: Q61文章STK11仅31例有覆盖，不能以全部365例为分母。

cards.zh: 终点起算时点与延迟进入风险集
cards.use_when: 分别定义OS、PFS及风险集进入时点；比较时保留治疗线别。
cards.confusable: 从诊断开始的OS不能当作从用药开始的OS；左截断不等于右删失。
cards.safe_example: OS was measured from [diagnosis], whereas PFS began at [treatment initiation].
cards.unsafe_example: Different index dates represent the same survival estimand.
cards.boundary: 不能因同称OS就直接合并治疗方案优劣。

cards.zh: 调整后效应量与未调整检验分开报告
cards.use_when: 核对HR及P值是否来自同一个模型，注明真实协变量。
cards.confusable: 图中调整后HR旁边的log-rank P不是调整后Cox P；非分层不等于多变量调整。
cards.safe_example: The adjusted HR was [estimate]; the displayed P value was from the log-rank comparison.
cards.unsafe_example: Every P value next to an adjusted HR was adjusted for all co-mutations.
cards.boundary: 主文只转述补充模型时不能声称已核对其全部参数。

cards.zh: 效应量与区间内部一致性核对
collocations: the reported interval was internally inconsistent
cards.use_when: 先核对端点、比较方向、点估计是否落在区间内及正文图表一致性。
cards.confusable: 图表与正文冲突不能靠猜测选一个；HR方向颠倒也不能只改数字。
cards.safe_example: The source reports conflicting intervals; the disputed interval is withheld pending clarification.
cards.unsafe_example: The HR was outside its CI, so we silently corrected the CI.
cards.boundary: 隔离问题数字，不将整个文章的安全术语误判为不可用。

cards.zh: 未达显著差异，不等于相同或等效
collocations: no statistically significant difference was detected
cards.use_when: 保留效应量和区间，并说明是否真正设计了等效性检验。
cards.confusable: 未拒绝零假设不证明零效应；一个终点显著不自动使其他终点显著。
cards.safe_example: No statistically significant difference in [endpoint] was detected; equivalence was not tested.
cards.unsafe_example: Nonsignificance established identical recurrence risk.
cards.boundary: 禁止用unchanged替换未达显著；稀少亚组尤其需要精度提示。

cards.zh: 中位数未达到与置信区间上限未估出
collocations: the upper confidence limit was not estimable
cards.use_when: 确认NR标记对应哪个终点以及中位数还是区间端点。
cards.confusable: PFS区间上限NR不是PFS中位数NR；OS未达到不能套到PFS。
cards.safe_example: Median [endpoint] was [value], with an upper confidence limit that was not estimable.
cards.unsafe_example: A missing upper CI means that median PFS was not reached.
cards.boundary: 表头、曲线横轴、图注须共同核对。

cards.zh: 表达亚型与突变归组不是同一标签
cards.use_when: 分别给出分型算法、训练/验证集和基因型分配规则。
cards.confusable: KL表达群可以没有检测到STK11突变；KLm/KPLm是另一种分组。
cards.safe_example: The expression-defined subgroup was enriched for [alteration], but membership was not determined solely by mutation status.
cards.unsafe_example: Every tumor in the KL expression cluster was STK11-mutant.
cards.boundary: 共聚类或富集不证明因果驱动。

cards.zh: 区域共缺失与单基因归因
cards.use_when: 呈现共缺失范围、联合基因型及不一致组样本量。
cards.confusable: 相关邻近基因不能靠多变量模型自动分离因果贡献。
cards.safe_example: Tight linkage and sparse discordant groups limited attribution to an individual gene.
cards.unsafe_example: Co-deletion proves each neighboring gene independently causes the outcome.
cards.boundary: 19p和9p21.3只作结构类比，不互借生物学机制。

cards.zh: 跨组学、临床队列的证据衔接
cards.use_when: 每次转入新数据集时重报来源、N和检测平台。
cards.confusable: 不同患者队列中方向一致不是同一患者的中介链。
cards.safe_example: In [clinical cohort], loss was associated with outcome. In a separate [RNA/protein dataset], loss was associated with lower expression; mediation was not tested.
cards.unsafe_example: TCGA expression proved mediation of outcomes in every DFCI patient.
cards.boundary: 段落合成必须保留队列转换，不能为流畅而删去。

cards.zh: 小鼠单细胞实测与人群bulk反卷积
collocations: immune composition inferred from bulk RNA
cards.use_when: 先给物种、样本单位、测序方式，再讲细胞类型或状态。
cards.confusable: 人群反卷积不是人单细胞实测；单细胞来源克隆也不等于单细胞组学。
cards.safe_example: Mouse scRNA-seq characterized cell states, whereas human immune composition was inferred from bulk profiles.
cards.unsafe_example: Human single-cell sequencing validated the result when only bulk RNA was analyzed.
cards.boundary: 不把细胞数当独立动物重复数。

cards.zh: IHC、mIF与靶向RPPA检测分开命名
cards.use_when: 按真实实验命名，注明组织细胞密度、蛋白量或磷酸化读出。
cards.confusable: CD8单标IHC不是mIF；mIF不是空间转录组；RPPA不是全局质谱蛋白组。
cards.safe_example: CD8 density was assessed by [single-marker IHC], not multiplex or transcriptome-wide profiling.
cards.unsafe_example: A CD8 IHC comparison established spatial multi-omics.
cards.boundary: G12V文章的旧mIF条目已隔离。

cards.zh: 相对保留、比例富集与绝对数量
collocations: as a fraction of CD45-positive cells
cards.use_when: 说明分母是活细胞、CD45细胞、非肿瘤细胞还是组织面积。
cards.confusable: 比值升高可能由分母减少造成，不能自动写成分子细胞绝对扩增。
cards.safe_example: The ratio increased alongside depletion of [denominator population]; absolute expansion was not established.
cards.unsafe_example: A higher TH1/CD8 ratio proves all CD4 cells expanded.
cards.boundary: 保留模型及测量时点差异；Treg未减少不能写成被清除。

cards.zh: 实验单位、技术复孔与嵌套样本
cards.use_when: 报告独立动物/培养实验N、每个单位内技术测量及分层重抽样。
cards.confusable: 数千细胞或肿瘤条码不是数千独立动物；三复孔不等于三次独立实验。
cards.safe_example: Uncertainty was estimated by resampling mice and then tumors within mice.
cards.unsafe_example: Every cell or barcode constituted an independent biological replicate.
cards.boundary: 只有实际采用的重抽样层级才能写入Methods。

cards.zh: 回补、敲低与方向特异的实验解释
cards.use_when: 分别检查基因状态、对照方向、药物及实验条件。
cards.confusable: 回补与敲低的效应方向不能合成同一句升高；不同药物不能概括为全类显著。
cards.safe_example: [Perturbation] altered sensitivity to [compound] in [model]; the direction and exceptions were reported separately.
cards.unsafe_example: Restoration and knockdown both increased IC50 in all models.
cards.boundary: CD2015正文与Fig7D冲突保留，以具体图组表述并警示。

cards.zh: 选择性配对样本中的新检出事件
collocations: detected at progression in paired samples
cards.use_when: 列出初始人群、重复活检、面板覆盖和配对可评价的逐层分母。
cards.confusable: 进展时新检出不直接证明新发生、治疗诱导或耐药因果。
cards.safe_example: The alteration was newly detected in [number] of [assay-covered paired cases], warranting functional follow-up.
cards.unsafe_example: Two selected progression biopsies proved a universal acquired-resistance mechanism.
cards.boundary: 不能将配对亚集频率套到全队列。

cards.zh: 原文不一致的透明陈述
collocations: the text and figure report different values
cards.use_when: 注明来源版本、正文/图表位置、冲突内容及使用处置。
cards.confusable: 原文冲突不应静默修补；存在冲突也不等于整篇文献无效。
cards.safe_example: The text and figure disagree on [item]; we retain the supported conclusion but withhold the disputed value.
cards.unsafe_example: We selected the more plausible value without documenting the disagreement.
cards.boundary: 更正记录与原始阅读记录并存，不能覆盖历史以制造一致。

cards.zh: 从知识缺口到有边界的研究目标
cards.use_when: 说明已有证据能回答什么、尚不能回答什么，再引出本研究实际目标。
cards.confusable: remainuncertain不是从未有人研究；结构相似不是同一基因机制。
cards.safe_example: Existing genomic associations do not fully resolve [functional or clinical question], motivating [the analysis actually performed].
cards.unsafe_example: An MTAP paper establishes the missing STK11 mechanism.
cards.boundary: 不夸大创新性，不替用户新增未完成分析。

cards.zh: 结论层的研究依据与临床效用边界
cards.use_when: 综合多层证据后说明尚需何种验证，而不是直接给出患者选择规则。
cards.confusable: 模型机制与探索性试验亚组相互支持，仍不等于临床预测标志物已验证。
cards.safe_example: These findings support prospective evaluation of [strategy] in [defined context], without establishing a universal treatment-selection rule.
cards.unsafe_example: The retrospective association establishes which therapy every STK11 patient must receive.
cards.boundary: 仅用于科研写作，不用于个体诊疗决策。
